## Checklist

- [ ] Title follows conventional commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, ...)
- [ ] `cargo fmt`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo test` pass locally
- [ ] New behaviour has a test that failed before the change
- [ ] No fixtures or examples cut from private or employer code
- [ ] Docs and README updated when behaviour or commands changed
